---
title: "Data Inspector Table Sorting"
---

## Overview

Mask, Line, Point, Digital Event Series, and Digital Interval Series inspectors display tabular data through custom `QAbstractTableModel` subclasses. Each model materializes rows into a `_display_data` vector and sorts that vector in place when the user clicks a column header.

Sorting is implemented via `sort()` overrides backed by the shared helper [`InspectorTableSort.hpp`](../../../../src/WhiskerToolbox/DataInspector_Widget/utils/InspectorTableSort.hpp).

## Default sort

On load and after data refresh or group filtering, models apply the current sort state. The default is ascending order on the primary time column:

| Inspector | Default column |
|-----------|----------------|
| Mask, Line, Point | Frame |
| Digital Event Series | Frame |
| Digital Interval Series | Start |

## Sortable columns

### Mask (`MaskTableModel`)

| Column | Sort key |
|--------|----------|
| Frame | `int64_t` frame index |
| Mask Index | per-frame mask index |
| Total Points | mask point count |
| Group | group name (`QString`) |

### Line (`LineTableModel`)

| Column | Sort key |
|--------|----------|
| Frame | `int64_t` frame index |
| Line Index | per-frame line index |
| Length (points) | line point count |
| Group | group name |

### Point (`PointTableModel`)

| Column | Sort key |
|--------|----------|
| Frame | `int64_t` frame index |
| Point Index | per-frame point index |
| X | point X coordinate |
| Y | point Y coordinate |
| Group | group name |

### Digital Event Series (`EventTableModel`)

| Column | Sort key |
|--------|----------|
| Frame | `TimeFrameIndex` value |
| Group | group name |

### Digital Interval Series (`IntervalTableModel`)

| Column | Sort key |
|--------|----------|
| Start | interval start index |
| End | interval end index |
| Duration | inclusive `end - start + 1` |
| Group | group name |

## Implementation notes

- Sorting reorders `_display_data` only; underlying `MaskData`, `LineData`, etc. storage order is unchanged.
- `getRowData()`, selection, and context menus use model row indices and therefore reflect the sorted view.
- Table views call `configureDefaultInspectorTableSort()` so the header sort indicator stays Frame/Start ascending across model resets (Qt otherwise re-sorts on `endResetModel()` using the header indicator).
- Header clicks invoke `model->sort()`.
- Sort uses `std::stable_sort` to preserve relative order among equal keys.

## Out of scope

Tensor Inspector uses a lazy virtual table model and is not covered by this sorting implementation.
